[24] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ EN: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness.

[25] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ EN: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth remain by His command.

spans.text: [24] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ EN: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness.

folded.id: and it|is|he who begins creation
folded.subject: And it

spans.text: [27] AR: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him.

folded.id: and that|is|[even] easier for him
folded.subject: and that

spans.text: [27] AR: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him.

folded.id: and there|will|not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors
folded.subject: And there
folded.object: not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors

spans.text: [13] AR: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ EN: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.

folded.id: and thus|will|you be brought out
folded.subject: And thus

spans.text: And thus will you be brought out.

folded.id: denied our|verses|and the meeting of the hereafter
folded.subject: denied Our
folded.object: and the meeting of the Hereafter

spans.text: [16] AR: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ EN: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

folded.id: detail the|verses|for a people who use reason
folded.subject: detail the
folded.object: for a people who use reason

spans.text: Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.

folded.id: do you|have|among those whom your right hands possess any partners in what we have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]?
folded.subject: Do you
folded.object: among those whom your right hands possess any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]?

spans.text: Do you have among those whom your right hands possess any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]?

folded.id: exalted|is|he] at night and when you are at noon
folded.subject: exalted
folded.object: He] at night and when you are at noon

spans.text: And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.

folded.id: he|brings|the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness
folded.subject: He
folded.object: the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness

spans.text: [19] AR: يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ EN: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness.

folded.id: he|gives|victory to whom he wills
folded.subject: He

spans.text: He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

folded.id: him you|will|be returned
folded.subject: Him you

spans.text: [11] AR: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ EN: Allah begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.

folded.id: his signs|is|that he created you from dust
folded.subject: His signs
folded.object: that He created you from dust

spans.text: [20] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌۭ تَنتَشِرُونَ EN: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].

[21] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةًۭ وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ EN: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy.

[24] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ EN: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness.

folded.id: his signs|is|the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors
folded.subject: His signs
folded.object: the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors

spans.text: [22] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْعَٰلِمِينَ EN: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors.

[23] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ EN: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty.

[25] AR: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ EN: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth remain by His command.

folded.id: immediately you|will|come forth
folded.subject: immediately you

spans.text: Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.

folded.id: know what|is|apparent of the worldly life
folded.subject: know what

spans.text: [7] AR: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَٰهِرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ EN: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.

folded.id: so exalted|is|allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning
folded.subject: So exalted
folded.object: Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning

spans.text: [17] AR: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ EN: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.

folded.id: than they|have|built it up
folded.subject: than they

spans.text: They were greater than them in power, and they plowed the earth and built it up more than they have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences.

folded.id: the believers|will|rejoice
folded.subject: the believers

spans.text: And that day the believers will rejoice

folded.id: the byzantines|have|been defeated
folded.subject: The Byzantines

spans.text: [2] AR: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ EN: The Byzantines have been defeated

folded.id: the hour|appears|the criminals will be in despair
folded.subject: the Hour
folded.object: the criminals will be in despair

spans.text: [12] AR: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ EN: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
[14] AR: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ EN: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.

folded.id: then he|repeats|it
folded.subject: then He

spans.text: [27] AR: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him.

folded.id: then he|will|repeat it
folded.subject: then He

spans.text: [11] AR: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ EN: Allah begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.

folded.id: they|will|be in a garden [of paradise]
folded.subject: they

spans.text: [15] AR: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍۢ يُحْبَرُونَ EN: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.

folded.id: those|will|be brought into the punishment [to remain]
folded.subject: those
folded.object: be brought into the punishment [to remain]

spans.text: [16] AR: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ EN: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

folded.id: to allah|belongs|the command before and after
folded.subject: To Allah

spans.text: To Allah belongs the command before and after.

folded.id: to him|belongs|whoever is in the heavens and earth
folded.subject: to Him
folded.object: whoever is in the heavens and earth

spans.text: [26] AR: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ EN: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth.
To Him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth.

folded.id: to him|devoutly|obedient
folded.subject: to Him

spans.text: All are to Him devoutly obedient.

folded.id: to him|is|[due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth
folded.subject: to Him
folded.object: [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth

spans.text: [18] AR: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّۭا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ EN: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth.

folded.id: whom allah|has|sent astray?
folded.subject: whom Allah

spans.text: Then who can guide one whom Allah has sent astray?
